gpu_evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 executed three FlyDSL vector-add tests and a direct HIP-event torch.add benchmark; the latter matched an independently generated NumPy CPU reference exactly.
remaining_limitations: No C++, MLIR, or LLVM source changed, so the prepared native rebuild was not applicable; native imports used /opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/flydsl/_mlir.
CUDA/NVIDIA hardware, HIP graph mode, and the torch.profiler timing mode were not independently exercised.
Two compile-hint cases retained their existing architecture/feature skips.

pandas remains required only when get_trace_perf or the default torch.profiler timing path performs dataframe processing; that path now raises a focused optional-dependency ImportError when pandas is absent.
